title: Vera Rubin hardware reference database

gap_analysis: hwdb v1.5: die-locality how-to published (topics/die-locality-howto.md) and verified on Rhea (hw6, hw7). Measured: 106 SMs per die (pair rule holds for the 12 non-split SMs); die-local read 1.41x striped with the full map; one VA range of alternating 2 MiB die chunks + die-matched claim = die-local rate, die-oblivious claim = striped; per-SM read throughput cap means a die-local stream needs all SMs of the die; one die alone = half chip; writes gain nothing, copies 1.2x; graph capture with localized memory works; torch LocalizedAllocator pools in the image home tensors per die incl. inside graph capture; no green-context launch penalty with empty kernels. New (hw7-hw9): TMA ring throughput per issuing thread = bytes per stage / ~0.37 us regardless of ring depth; the standard GEMM form (one producer warp, 16 KiB boxes) caps at ~0.5-0.6x of die-local for any placement, so die-localizing such kernels gains nothing until each issuer moves >= 32 KiB per stage or 2+ issuers stream; the MegaMoE weight operand (one TMA warp, 8-16 KiB per stage) is flagged as issue-capped (hw10 MegaMoE-like stage probe running); per-die SM split varies by part (106/106, 108/104); per-row 1D bulk and gather4 row gathers are op-rate bound, warp loads are the fast gather. Earlier: tcgen05 smem-operand cap 2/3 (A in TMEM or 2-CTA for peak), NVLink multicast latency.
inefficiencies: No Nsight Compute/Systems in the K3.1 image: counter-based root-causing (bytes, tensor pipe utilisation) is unavailable to every workstream unless a host install is mounted (flagged to INFRA in briefs/INFRA.md)
Counted TMA stores, early A-buffer release MMA flag and TMA L2 management ops exist in hardware/ptxas internals but have no public PTX spelling in CUDA 13.4
